prompt.project_info: Two-pose photorealistic commercial-gym fitness portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original athletic woman with light tan or olive skin, dark-brown hair in a high slightly messy ponytail and two natural expressions: focused while lifting and relaxed with a subtle smile while standing. She wears a mauve/dusty-rose/muted-earthy-brown seamless ribbed activewear set with scoop-neck sports bra and high-waisted full-length leggings, plus large white over-ear headphones.
prompt.composition_elements: Create two distinct poses: seated dumbbell press on a flat bench with black dumbbells at shoulder height, and standing cable-rope tricep pushdown near a cable machine while looking to the side. Modern gym with blurred racks, dumbbells, benches, mirrors and warm track lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm cinematic indoor lighting with gentle skin highlights, shallow depth of field and focused upscale commercial-gym atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealism, sharp fabric and face detail, natural anatomy, realistic ribbed compression texture and gym background bokeh.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Two-pose photorealistic fitness portrait of a clearly adult original athletic woman with dark-brown hair in a high messy ponytail, wearing a mauve dusty-rose ribbed seamless sports bra and high-waisted full-length leggings with white over-ear headphones, first seated on a bench performing a dumbbell press and second standing at a cable machine performing a rope tricep pushdown, blurred gym racks and mirrors, soft warm cinematic light, realistic fabric and skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, sexualized pose, exaggerated anatomy, logos, text, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, extra fingers, deformed anatomy
